title: GitHub Release Download Count Leaderboard
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:release download_count=*
| stats sum(download_count) as total_value, avg(download_count) as avg_value by repo_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks repository values by total and average download count across GitHub release events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `download_count` values for each GitHub release event and review total and average download count by repository.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total download count.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which repository shows the biggest download count numbers in your GitHub release data.
